name: io.github.xorrkaz/cml-mcp
title: Cisco Modeling Labs CML
description: An MCP server that provides access to common Cisco Modeling Labs (CML) operations.

environmentVariables.description: Username for CML authentication (mutually exclusive with CML_JWT; required together with CML_PASSWORD if CML_JWT is not set)
environmentVariables.name: CML_USERNAME

environmentVariables.description: Password for CML authentication (mutually exclusive with CML_JWT; required together with CML_USERNAME if CML_JWT is not set)
environmentVariables.name: CML_PASSWORD

environmentVariables.description: Long-lived CML API token (personal access token) used instead of CML_USERNAME/CML_PASSWORD. Mutually exclusive with them; required if they are not set. Can be replaced at runtime via the set_cml_jwt tool without restarting.
environmentVariables.name: CML_JWT
